user.title: Follow 112 dispatches
user.description: Pick what you want to hear about. Leave everything empty and you get the whole of the Netherlands — that is hundreds a day. Capcodes for your own station are listed on 112hier.nl/alerts; calls for those always come through. The keyword fields accept * and ?, for example *Epe*.
